A nested table forces the whole outer table into raw HTML.

<table>
<tr><th>Outer head</th><th>Second head</th></tr>
<tr><td><table>
<tr><th>inner a</th><th>inner b</th></tr>
<tr><td>inner c</td><td>inner d</td></tr>
</table>
</td><td><strong>bold</strong> then <em>italic</em><br><del>struck</del> and <code>code | here</code></td></tr>
<tr><td>a &amp; b, and 3 &lt; 4</td><td>line one<br>line two</td></tr>
</table>

After the nested table.
